summary.en: Indie labels and major radio briefly share a playlist; loud/quiet becomes default song form.
summary.zh: 独立厂牌与主流电台短暂共用歌单；强弱对比成为默认曲式。

sound.en: Fuzz and overdrive pedals, soft–loud verse–chorus, dry room mics, modern-rock radio compression, twin-vocal harmony on Alice in Chains sides
sound.zh: Fuzz / 过载效果器、弱–强主歌副歌、干房间话筒、现代摇滚电台压缩、Alice in Chains 式双人声和声

body.en:
Sub Pop and Seattle clubs feed major labels. Nirvana’s Nevermind (1991) puts power-chord soft–loud (Pixies-adjacent) on MTV and Billboard. Pearl Jam’s Ten (1991), Soundgarden’s Badmotorfinger / Superunknown (1991–94), and Alice in Chains’ Dirt (1992) share the same US modern-rock window with different guitar and vocal approaches.

Outside Seattle, Radiohead moves from Pablo Honey / The Bends guitar singles toward OK Computer (1997) studio density. Foo Fighters (1995) carry post-Nirvana drummer-fronted alt onto the same radio format.

UK Britpop runs in parallel on different charts and press; this chapter stays on the US-leaning alternative and grunge shock.
body.zh:
Sub Pop 与西雅图俱乐部把乐队送进大厂。Nirvana《Nevermind》（1991）把强力和弦弱–强（近 Pixies）送上 MTV 与 Billboard。Pearl Jam《Ten》（1991）、Soundgarden《Badmotorfinger》《Superunknown》（1991–94）、Alice in Chains《Dirt》（1992）同处美国现代摇滚窗口，吉他与人声路径不同。

西雅图之外，Radiohead 从《Pablo Honey》《The Bends》吉他单曲转向《OK Computer》（1997）的录音室密度。Foo Fighters（1995）把 Nirvana 之后鼓手领衔的另类推上同一电台格式。

英国 Britpop 在另一套榜单与媒体上并行；本章保留偏美的替代与 Grunge 冲击。
